title: Privilege delegation & escalation flows for RBAC v2 with SSO audit macros
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create an operational guide and support toolkit that documents the privileged delegation and emergency escalation flows for RBAC v2. Deliverables: a short runbook for oncall engineers, support macros to fetch and triage SSO/SAML audit events, JIT (just-in-time) elevation checklist, and automated queries/dashboards. This ticket focuses on procedures and macros (not on implementation of role-mapping code), and will consolidate learnings from the Feb 2025 privileged-access incident to reduce mean time to recovery for admin faults.

runbook_snippets: Emergency elevation flow (high level): 1) Open escalation ticket (CS/Oncall) 2) Requestor posts identity proof link + ticket_id 3) Pager/manager approval via Slack approval action 4) Oncall executes 'rw-audit:elevations:48h' macro to record context 5) JIT grant issued with explicit expiry (max 1 hour) 6) Confirm access via 'rw-audit:active-admin-sessions' 7) When done, run 'rw-audit:revoke-session <session_id>' and close ticket

SAML attribute mapping example (IdP): <Attribute Name="https://schemas.redwood.ai/SAML/Role"> <AttributeValue>admin:platform</AttributeValue> </Attribute> — ensure assertion includes issuer fingerprint and audience field
Audit schema to capture for every elevation event: timestamp | actor_id | approver_id | request_ticket | role_granted | duration_seconds | session_id | originating_ip
Kibana query sample: event.action:"assume_role" AND destination.role:"admin:*" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 200

Support macro examples: rw-audit:elevations:48h -> returns CSV with columns [timestamp,actor,approver,role,session_id]. rw-audit:revoke-session <id> -> returns 200 + revocation_event_id or 404 if already revoked.
operational_notes: Trade-offs considered: automatic silent elevation (no human approval) vs strict approval: decided on JIT with human approver for all admin-scoped grants to preserve auditability and stakeholder trust.

Edge case: IdP returns both group and role attributes. Chosen policy: prefer explicit role attribute if present; otherwise map groups to default lower-privilege roles and require manual escalation for admin-level mappings.
Monitoring: Added Datadog monitor 'privilege-elevation-rate' that triggers PagerDuty at >5 elevation events in 5m window to catch potential abuse or automation bugs.
User education: Create a short runbook card and 1-page FAQ for Customer Support explaining why immediate revocation may be necessary and how to validate an approver's identity.
